visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) [People]: A young woman with short brown bob-cut hair and a brown jacket crouches in a retail store. She looks directly at the camera with a cheerful, expressive face, holding a blue-and-yellow snack bag with her left hand while gesturing with her right. [Objects]: The snack bag features a cartoon boy character. [Setting]: A brightly lit convenience store with rows of colorful packaged goods on white shelves. (2) [People]: The woman stands in an enclosed space, holding both the snack bag and a carton of chocolate milk. Her reflection is visible in the background. [Objects]: A white carton of milk with chocolate graphics is held prominently. [Setting]: The interior of an elevator with polished metal surfaces and a large mirror reflecting the woman’s back. (3) [People]: The woman is in a kitchen, leaning down to open a lower cabinet drawer. [Objects]: A white ceramic plate is placed on the counter. She pours small, round, tan-colored snacks from the bag onto the plate. [Setting]: A modern indoor kitchen with white cabinetry and a microwave oven. (4) [People]: The woman’s hand carefully pours chocolate milk from the carton over the pile of snacks on the plate. [Objects]: The snacks begin to float and soak in the dark brown liquid. She uses her finger to press down on the soaked snacks. [Setting]: A well-lit kitchen counter with various cooking utensils in the background. (5) [Objects]: A close-up shot shows the plate of snacks and milk inside a microwave through the glass door. The interior light is on, showing the plate rotating. [Setting]: The dark, illuminated interior of a microwave with a Tatung logo visible. (6) [People]: A television screen clip shows three individuals sitting on a talk show set. One woman wears a yellow and black patterned top and speaks animatedly, while the others react with expressions of shock. [Objects]: Microphones and colorful variety show graphics. [Setting]: A brightly lit television studio stage. (7) [People]: The woman and a friend take turns tasting the resulting mixture with a spoon. They both exhibit high-arousal facial expressions, wide eyes, and smiles. [Objects]: A sticky, brown, cohesive food mass. [Setting]: Transitions between the kitchen area and a living room with a sofa.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video document's a popular internet food trend where 'Wang Wang Little Steamed Buns' are mixed with chocolate milk and microwaved to create a mochi-like texture. The creator guides the viewer through the purchase, the DIY cooking steps, and provides a final taste review to verify the trend's validity.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video appears to be a user-generated challenge following a viral trend rather than a paid advertisement.
